# Claims

1. A helmet comprising:
   a shell;
   a light mounted on the shell; and
   a controller configured to activate the light.

2. The helmet of claim 1, wherein the battery is mounted inside the shell.

3. The helmet of claim 1, further comprising a strap coupled to the shell.

4. The helmet of claim 1, wherein the strap includes a buckle.

5. The helmet of claim 1, wherein the controller activates the light when the switch is pressed, and further comprising a switch.

6. The helmet of claim 1, further comprising a light mounted on a front of the shell, wherein the light is red.

7. The helmet of claim 1, wherein the lights are light-emitting diodes.
